hooks.name: player_logged_out_v2
hooks.neoforge: PlayerEvent.PlayerLoggedOutEvent (no reason there; Bukkit's PlayerQuitEvent with its kick and timeout causes)

rust_summary: why a player left (`native_player_logged_out_v2`): a `NativeQuitReason` after `native_player_logged_out`.
doc_summary: `native_player_logged_out_v2(player, name, reason)` is `native_player_logged_out` (NeoForge's `PlayerLoggedOutEvent`) with why the player left: `reason` is `Disconnected` (a clean disconnect, a connection reset, a move to another server), `Kicked(text)` (a server kick, `native_kick`, `/kick`, a ban, the packet-rate limit, with the text as the client shows it), `TimedOut` (the keep-alive timeout), `ServerStopping` (the server stops with them still listed) or `Error(text)` (a malformed packet or a read error). The first cause that ends the connection is kept, so a timeout after a kick stays `Kicked`. v1 keeps its signature and firing point and fires first; v2 fires right after it, for the same players, and only hears. Bundles need `"hooks": @API:player_logged_out_v2@`.
